title.value: The TREM2-APOE pathway drives the transcriptional phenotype of dysfunctional microglia in neurodegenerative diseases
title.quote: The TREM2-APOE pathway drives the transcriptional phenotype of dysfunctional microglia in neurodegenerative diseases

design.value: Preclinical mechanistic study: microglial transcriptome profiling (Nanostring, RNAseq), quantitative mass spectrometry, immunohistochemistry, genetic knockouts and ex vivo functional assays across mouse models of ALS, AD and MS, plus human post-mortem brain tissue
design.quote: To investigate underlying common molecular mechanisms that regulate microglial dysfunction, we isolated microglia and analyzed transcriptomes during aging and disease progression in mouse models of ALS (SOD1 G93A , expressing human Cu,Zn superoxide dismutase mutation)

population.value: Model systems, not living human participants: mouse models of ALS (SOD1 G93A), Alzheimer's disease (APP-PS1; 5XFAD transcriptomes) and multiple sclerosis (EAE), knockout and conditional-knockout mice (Apoe−/−, Trem2−/−, miR-155−/−, Cx3cr1CreERT2:Apoefl/fl), primary mouse neuron cultures and ex vivo microglia/T-cell assays, together with post-mortem human AD cortex including heterozygous TREM2 R47H and R62H carriers
population.quote: we isolated microglia and analyzed transcriptomes during aging and disease progression in mouse models of ALS (SOD1 G93A , expressing human Cu,Zn superoxide dismutase mutation), AD (APP-PS1, overexpressing mutated genes for human amyloid precursor protein and presenilin 1) and MS (experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis; EAE)

followup.value: Mouse analysis timepoints included APP-PS1 at 9 and 24 months, APP-PS1:Trem2−/− at 4 months, SOD1:Trem2 mice at 115 days, 7 days post-facial nerve axotomy, and 3 h to 14 days after apoptotic-neuron injection
followup.quote: These mice were analyzed at 9 and 24 months, respectively. APP-PS1: Trem2 −/− , were generated by crossing APP-PS1 mice with Trem2 −/− mice. These mice were analyzed at 4 months of age.

intervention.value: Genetic deletion of Apoe (global and microglia-specific via tamoxifen-inducible Cx3cr1CreERT2:Apoefl/fl), Trem2 and miR-155; stereotactic injection of apoptotic neurons, recombinant APOE, LPS, Zymosan or E. coli particles; kainic acid injection; facial nerve axotomy
intervention.quote: To assess an intrinsic role of APOE regulation in a cell-specific manner, we deleted Apoe in microglia using Cx3cr1 CreERT2 :Apoe fl/fl mice.
intervention.location: Results, APOE regulates the transcriptional and post-transcriptional program

comparator.value: Wild-type and littermate control mice (Cx3cr1 wt:Apoe fl/fl), PBS/saline-injected brains, non-phagocytic microglia, and common-variant AD patients (AD-TREM2 WT) for the human tissue comparison
comparator.quote: Recombination was induced in Cx3cr1 CreERT2 :Apoe fl/fl adult mice and Cx3cr1 wt :Apoe fl/fl littermates were used as controls.
comparator.location: STAR*METHODS, Conditional genetic deletion of Apoe in microglia

biomarker_confirmation.value: For the human post-mortem specimens, age, gender, disease severity (Braak stage, estimated CDR) and APOE genotype were determined for each patient; TREM2 mutation status distinguished AD-TREM2 R47H and R62H carriers from common-variant AD
biomarker_confirmation.quote: Beside age, gender and disease severity (Braak stage, estimated CDR), the APOE genotype was determined for each patient (see summary in ).

outcomes.name: Loss of homeostatic microglial genes (cluster 1) during aging and disease progression in SOD1, APP-PS1 and EAE mice
outcomes.effect_estimate: 68 homeostatic microglial genes lost, including P2ry12, Tmem119, Gpr34, Olfml3, Csf1r, Cx3Cr1, Tgfbr1 and Tgfb1
outcomes.quote: Cluster 1 was associated with loss of 68 homeostatic microglial genes, including P2ry12, Tmem119, Gpr34, Jun, Olfml3, Csf1r, Hexb, Mertk, Rhob, Cx3Cr1, Tgfbr1 and Tgfb1
outcomes.location: Results, Reciprocal induction of APOE and suppression of TGFβ signaling

outcomes.name: Upregulation of inflammatory molecules (cluster 2), with Apoe among the most upregulated genes
outcomes.effect_estimate: 28 inflammatory molecules upregulated including Spp1, Itgax, Axl, Lilrb4, Clec7a, Ccl2, Csf1 and Apoe
outcomes.quote: Cluster 2 was associated with upregulation of 28 inflammatory molecules including Spp1, Itgax, Axl, Lilrb4, Clec7a, Ccl2, Csf1 and Apoe , of which Apoe was one of the most upregulated genes
outcomes.location: Results, Reciprocal induction of APOE and suppression of TGFβ signaling

outcomes.name: P2RY12 microglial marker in human AD cortex, diffuse versus neuritic plaques
outcomes.effect_estimate: P2RY12 preserved in Aβ diffuse plaques and lost in pNF+ neuritic plaques (human post-mortem AD brain)
outcomes.quote: P2RY12 + microglia were preserved in Aβ diffuse plaques and P2RY12 signal was lost in pNF + neuritic plaques ().
outcomes.location: Results, The MGnD-microglia subset is associated with neuritic Aβ-plaques

outcomes.name: Correlation of P2RY12+ microglia loss with axonal dystrophy versus Aβ deposition in human AD brain
outcomes.effect_estimate: Loss of P2RY12+ microglia correlated with axonal dystrophy but not with the extent of Aβ deposition; APOE expression increased in microglia near Aβ plaques
outcomes.quote: Loss of P2RY12 + microglia correlated with axonal dystrophy, but not with the extent of Aβ deposition (). We found increased APOE expression in microglia in close proximity to Aβ-plaque ().
outcomes.location: Results, The MGnD-microglia subset is associated with neuritic Aβ-plaques

outcomes.name: Apoe induction in microglia after phagocytosis of injected apoptotic neurons (mouse cortex and hippocampus)
outcomes.effect_estimate: Apoe increased as early as 3 h post-injection, peaked at 16 h, with homeostatic P2ry12+Clec7a− microglia restored at 14 days
outcomes.quote: Increased Apoe was detected as early as 3 h post-injection and peaked at 16 h post-injection (). Restoration of homeostatic P2ry12 + Clec7a − microglia occurred at 14 days post-injection ().
outcomes.location: Results, Phagocytosis of apoptotic neurons suppresses homeostatic microglia

outcomes.name: Quantitative mass spectrometry of phagocytic (MG-dNΦ) versus non-phagocytic (MG-nΦ) microglia
outcomes.effect_estimate: Apoe and Lgals3 increased; homeostatic proteins Rgs10 and Bin1 suppressed in phagocytic microglia
outcomes.quote: Quantitative mass spectrometry of MG-dNΦ vs. MG-nΦ microglia showed increased Apoe and Lgals3 in MG-dNΦ microglia. In contrast, both Rgs10 and Bin1, two homeostatic microglial proteins (), were suppressed
outcomes.location: Results, Phagocytosis of apoptotic neurons suppresses homeostatic microglia

outcomes.name: Genes induced in wild-type phagocytic microglia that are repressed when Apoe is deleted
outcomes.effect_estimate: 885 genes induced in WT MG-dNΦ microglia were repressed in Apoe−/− MG-dNΦ microglia
outcomes.quote: Cluster 1 showed 885 genes induced in MG-dNΦ WT microglia which were repressed in Apoe −/− MG-dNΦ microglia.
outcomes.location: Results, APOE regulates the transcriptional and post-transcriptional program

outcomes.name: Homeostatic genes suppressed in wild-type phagocytic microglia that are restored when Apoe is deleted
outcomes.effect_estimate: 1,220 suppressed genes restored in Apoe−/− MG-dNΦ microglia; 40 of the 68 genes commonly suppressed in disease were restored
outcomes.quote: Clusters 2 and 3 showed 1,220 suppressed genes in WT MG-dNΦ which were restored in Apoe −/− MG-dNΦ microglia. Among 68 genes commonly suppressed in disease, 40 genes were restored in Apoe −/− phagocytic microglia
outcomes.location: Results, APOE regulates the transcriptional and post-transcriptional program

outcomes.name: Neuronal loss in the axotomized facial motor nucleus after global or microglia-conditional Apoe deletion
outcomes.effect_estimate: Reduced neuronal loss compared with WT or Cx3cr1 WT:Apoe fl/fl mice (no numeric estimate in the retrieved text)
outcomes.quote: Global and conditional deletion of Apoe in microglia reduced neuronal loss as compared to WT or Cx3cr1 WT :Apoe fl/fl mice in the axotomized facial motor nucleus ( and ).
outcomes.location: Results, APOE regulates the transcriptional and post-transcriptional program

outcomes.name: miR-155 expression relative to the APOE pathway in phagocytic microglia
outcomes.effect_estimate: miR-155 suppressed in Apoe−/− phagocytic microglia while Apoe was unaffected in miR-155−/− microglia, placing miR-155 downstream of APOE
outcomes.quote: In MG-dNΦ microglia from Apoe −/− mice, miR-155 expression was suppressed (). In contrast, expression of Apoe was unaffected in miR-155 −/− MG-dNΦ microglia (). Thus, miR-155 expression was regulated downstream of the APOE pathway.
outcomes.location: Results, APOE regulates the transcriptional and post-transcriptional program

outcomes.name: Microglial phagocytosis of apoptotic neurons after blocking phosphatidylserine with Annexin V
outcomes.quote: We found blocking phosphatidylserine on apoptotic neurons with Annexin V protein (), reduced microglial phagocytosis by 88% ().
outcomes.location: Results, Genetic targeting of Trem2 suppresses the APOE pathway

outcomes.name: Homeostatic gene expression and Apoe/miR-155 in Trem2−/− phagocytic microglia
outcomes.effect_estimate: P2ry12, Gpr34, Tmem119, Tgfbr1 and Csf1r restored, while Apoe and miR-155 were suppressed, in Trem2−/− phagocytic microglia
outcomes.quote: We found that expression of homeostatic genes including P2ry12, Gpr34, Tmem119, Tgfbr1 and Csf1r , was restored in Trem2 −/− MG-dNΦ as compared to WT MG-dNΦ microglia (), whereas Apoe and miR-155 were suppressed in Trem2 −/− MG-dNΦ microglia
outcomes.location: Results, Genetic targeting of Trem2 suppresses the APOE pathway

outcomes.name: Microglial transcriptome of APP-PS1: Trem2 −/− mice (Nanostring profiling)
outcomes.effect_estimate: 7 inflammatory molecules (Trem2, Axl, Clec7a, Csf1, Itgax, Cd34, Apoe) suppressed; of 108 restored genes, 54 were commonly suppressed homeostatic microglial genes
outcomes.quote: Nanostring profiling of brain microglia from APP-PS1: Trem2 −/− mice showed suppression of 7 inflammatory molecules ( Trem2, Axl, Clec7a, Csf1, Itgax, Cd34 and Apoe), which were among the most upregulated genes in the common disease-associated signature ().
outcomes.location: Results, Genetic targeting of Trem2 suppresses the APOE pathway

outcomes.name: Aβ-plaque load in APP-PS1: Trem2 −/− mice
outcomes.effect_estimate: decreased Aβ-plaque load in APP-PS1: Trem2 −/− mice (no numeric estimate in the retrieved text)
outcomes.quote: Consistent with previous findings (), the Aβ-plaque load was decreased in APP-PS1: Trem2 −/− mice ().
outcomes.location: Results, Genetic targeting of Trem2 suppresses the APOE pathway

outcomes.name: Gender-dependent TREM2 regulation of microglia in SOD1 mice (RNAseq)
outcomes.effect_estimate: 279 commonly affected genes, 575 female-specific genes and 2,639 male-specific genes
outcomes.quote: We found 279 commonly affected genes (cluster 2) and gender-specific genes (575 genes in females, cluster 1 and 2,639 genes in males, cluster 3) ( and ).
outcomes.location: Results, Genetic targeting of Trem2 suppresses the APOE pathway

outcomes.name: Microglial distribution and TMEM119 intensity in human AD carriers of TREM2 R47H and R62H variants
outcomes.effect_estimate: Microglia more evenly distributed and not clustered around Aβ plaques; TMEM119 intensity significantly higher in both TREM2 mutation carriers
outcomes.quote: microglia were more evenly distributed within the cortex in AD-TREM2 in both types of mutations and did not cluster around Aβ plaques as in AD-TREM2 WT (). Moreover, TMEM119 intensity was significantly higher in both TREM2 mutation carriers
outcomes.location: Results, Genetic targeting of Trem2 suppresses the APOE pathway

outcomes.name: Tolerogenic function of microglia (ex vivo suppression of T cell proliferation) after recombinant APOE stimulation
outcomes.effect_estimate: recombinant Apoe abrogated the tolerogenic function of microglia and did not affect T cell proliferation in the absence of microglia
outcomes.quote: Stimulation of microglia with recombinant Apoe (rApoe) abrogated tolerogenic function of microglia. rApoe did not affect T cell proliferation in the absence of microglia ().
outcomes.location: Results, Activation of the APOE pathway suppresses the tolerogenic function of microglia

outcomes.name: Tolerogenic function of Apoe−/− microglia at peak EAE
outcomes.effect_estimate: Apoe−/− spinal cord microglia at disease peak suppressed T cell proliferation, unlike WT-EAE microglia
outcomes.quote: We then induced EAE in WT and Apoe −/− mice and found that unlike WT-EAE microglia, Apoe −/− microglia from spinal cord at disease peak suppressed T cell proliferation ()
outcomes.location: Results, Activation of the APOE pathway suppresses the tolerogenic function of microglia

primary_endpoint_status.explanation: This is a mechanistic laboratory study in mouse models, cell assays and post-mortem human tissue with no prespecified clinical endpoint, so there is no primary endpoint to meet or miss.
primary_endpoint_status.quote: Taken together, our work identifies the TREM2-APOE pathway as a major regulator of microglial functional phenotype in neurodegenerative diseases and serves as a novel target to restore homeostatic microglia.

multiplicity.approach: No multiplicity-control scheme is described for the reported comparisons; the document states that 2-tailed unpaired Student's t tests or ANOVA multiple comparison tests were used, with a 1% FDR applied in the mass spectrometry analysis and a nominal P<0.001 threshold with 1,000 permutations for GSEA
multiplicity.quote: Data are presented as mean ± s.e.m and 2-tailed Student’s t tests (unpaired) or ANOVA multiple comparison tests were used to assess statistical significance.

limitations: Data distribution was assumed to be normal, but this was not formally tested.
Neuronal apoptosis is a rare event in human AD ().
Although TREM2 polymorphisms are associated with a risk for late onset AD (), its role in neurodegenerative diseases is controversial.
We found that APOE ligand suppresses major transcription factors of homeostatic microglia. Future studies will determine whether the effect is TREM2-dependent.
MGnD microglia may also be protective and represent an initial response to neuronal injury.
This is a PDF file of an unedited manuscript that has been accepted for publication.

risk_of_bias.judgement: The central mechanistic manipulations (Apoe, Trem2 and miR-155 deletion, apoptotic-neuron injection, facial nerve axotomy) are performed in mice; the human component is post-mortem immunohistochemistry, so the causal claims rest on mouse and ex vivo systems
risk_of_bias.quote: Targeting TREM2 signaling in the facial nerve axotomy (FNA) model also ameliorated neuronal loss in Trem2 −/− mice ().

risk_of_bias.judgement: Quantification of APOE signal in human microglia was based on 30 cells each from three AD subjects versus three controls
risk_of_bias.quote: Selected area was 300 μm 2 and 30 cells were measured each (n = 3 AD subjects vs. n = 3 controls).

risk_of_bias.judgement: Facial nerve axotomy experiments used n = 4–5 mice per group, and plaque-associated marker quantification used n = 5 mice per genotype
risk_of_bias.quote: Unilateral facial nerve transection at the stylomastoid foramen was performed in WT, ApoE −/− , Trem2 −/− , and Cx3cr1 CreERT2 :ApoE fl/fl and Cx3cr1 wt :ApoE fl/fl (control) mice (n = 4–5/group).

risk_of_bias.judgement: Normality was assumed rather than tested before applying t tests and ANOVA across many transcriptomic and imaging comparisons
risk_of_bias.quote: Data distribution was assumed to be normal, but this was not formally tested.

risk_of_bias.judgement: The retrieved text is an accepted but unedited author manuscript, which the document itself warns may contain errors before final publication
risk_of_bias.quote: This is a PDF file of an unedited manuscript that has been accepted for publication.

disagreements.question: Is APOE induction in disease-associated microglia TREM2-dependent?
disagreements.position: This document reports that genetic targeting of Trem2 suppresses the APOE pathway and restores homeostatic microglia in APP-PS1 and SOD1 mice, against a prior report that APOE induction is TREM2-independent in 5XFAD mice
disagreements.attributed_to: this document's authors, disagreeing with Keren-Shaul et al.
disagreements.quote: Keren-Shaul et al. reported that APOE induction is TREM2-independent in 5XFAD mice (), though Apoe expression in 5XFAD mice was moderately reduced in the previous study (). We found genetic targeting of Trem2 suppresses the APOE pathway

disagreements.question: Is TREM2 deficiency beneficial or harmful in Alzheimer's disease models?
disagreements.position: This document notes the field is contradictory (Wang et al. versus Jay et al.) and reports that targeting Trem2 in APP-PS1 mice at early stages restored homeostatic microglia with reduced Aβ plaques
disagreements.attributed_to: this document's authors, contrasting Wang et al. and Jay et al.
disagreements.quote: We found that genetic targeting of Trem2 in APP-PS1 mice at early stages restored homeostatic microglia associated with the reduction of Aβ plaques.

disagreements.question: Is microglial APOE protective or detrimental in AD?
disagreements.position: This document concludes that microglial APOE may play a detrimental role in AD, forming an APOE-enriched microenvironment with plaques and dystrophic neurites
disagreements.quote: Our results are consistent with a report that increased APOE in CSF is associated with cognitive decline (). Thus, microglial APOE may play a detrimental role in AD.

disagreements.question: Does the MGnD phenotype correspond to classical M1 activation?
disagreements.position: This document argues the MG-dNΦ molecular signature is distinct from classical M1-induced microglia, because LPS/IFNγ suppressed Apoe and induced Egr1 in the opposite direction
disagreements.quote: Thus, the MG-dNΦ molecular signature is distinct from classical M1-induced microglia.

disagreements.question: Is there a sex difference in TREM2 regulation of microglia?
disagreements.position: This document reports TREM2 gender-dependent regulation of microglia in SOD1 mice and states this was not addressed by the prior studies it compares itself with
disagreements.attributed_to: this document's authors, relative to Wang et al. and Keren-Shaul et al.
disagreements.quote: We identified TREM2 gender-dependent regulation of microglia in SOD1 mice, which was not addressed by Wang et al. , and Keren-Shaul et al .
